scope: Real training, campaign and phone controller in isolated VM DOM. No browser paint, phone touch hardware or audible output measured.

results.name: Phone lobby exposes training; five locked heroes have neutral placeholders and no planned URL requests
Actual victory credits enable UI upgrade and exact refund without losing portraits or claim slots
Portrait/story tabs keep acquisition separate from art; reward table has all 168 slots
New and old campaign menus use independent entry, phone preflight replaces one slot and saves frozen hero
Phone skill click arms legal map targets; one target tap commits AP/energy/CD without confirmation
Unfinished battle locks training in lobby and detail dismisses by backdrop or X
Explicit elite speaker uses hero placeholder; ordinary channels use their precise 38-model avatar
Phone area skill has an edge preview and can heal only a chosen wounded unit outside the default recipients
Long-press intel shows frozen elite range and exclusive skills, not inherited ordinary skill
Victory feedback shows actual points; archive write failure clears busy, retains result, and retries once
Indirect area order keeps the primary target, allows fewer secondary hits, and cancel spends nothing
